segments.text: smb2-quota
Userspace helper to display quota information for the Linux SMB client file system (CIFS)
Manual section:
SYNOPSIS
smb2-quota [[[p0]]] {options} {file system object}
DESCRIPTION
This tool is part of the cifs-utils suite.
smb2-quota is a userspace helper program for the Linux SMB client file system (CIFS).
This tool works by making an CIFS_QUERY_INFO IOCTL call to the Linux SMB client which in turn issues a SMB Query Info request and returns the result.
OPTIONS
[[p0]]/[[p1]]: Print help explaining the command line options.
[[p0]]/[[p1]]: Print quota information for the volume in tabular format. Amount Used | Quota Limit | Warning Level | Percent Used | Status | SID
[[p0]]/[[p1]]: Print quota information for the volume in csv format. SID,Amount Used,Quota Limit,Warning Level
[[p0]]/[[p1]]: Print quota information for the volume in raw format. - SID - Quota Used - Quota Threshold - Quota Limit
[[p0]]/[[p1]] is the default action if none is given.
NOTES

Kernel support for smb2-quota requires the CIFS_QUERY_INFO IOCTL which was initially introduced in the 4.20 kernel and is only implemented for mount points using SMB2 or above (see mount.cifs(8) vers option).
SEE ALSO
smbinfo(1)
AUTHOR
Kenneth D'souza <kdsouza@redhat.com>
The Linux CIFS Mailing list is the preferred place to ask questions regarding these programs.
